_comment: Grip poses of the fists style (G6c: the hand poses the slice's claw gauntlets are checked in; G5 builds the style's animations on them). Conventions in tools/herogen/anim/poses.py.

fists.stance._comment: Guard up: knees bent, left foot forward, both fists raised in front of the chin with the claws pointing forward and up at the target, the left a little ahead. Arm angles solved for grip and claw targets on the teen, with the claws clear of the face and the hair on the chibi, teen and adult (notes/artgen.md, G6c).

fists.strike._comment: A right claw thrust at the moment it lands: the arm straight forward at shoulder height, the claws leading, the chest turned into it, the left fist kept up in front of the chest.

fists.guard._comment: A cross block: both forearms raised and crossed well in front of the chin, the claws up and out over them.
